Gerencia 360 Music, Inc. v. Suno, Inc.
Round Hill Music LP v. Suno, Inc.
Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA, USA. Its site describes it as an AI music generator that creates original songs from a text prompt, including vocals, lyrics, and production, in under a minute. The company says millions of people use it, and it offers free daily use plus paid Pro and Premier plans. Pro is listed at 500 songs a month with access to v5.5, commercial use rights, a Song Editor, stem separation, and audio uploads of up to 8 minutes. Premier is listed at 2,000 songs a month and adds Suno Studio, described as a generative audio workstation, a multitrack editor, MIDI export, and Persona Voices.

The company's tracked product is Suno, in the Voice & Audio category, noted for music generation and IP provenance. Suno is the defendant in a set of copyright-related lawsuits. These include UMG Recordings, Inc. v. Suno, Inc., Beckham v. Suno, Inc., Lowery v. Suno, Inc., Rugnetta v. Suno, Inc., Pilavian v. Suno, Inc., Reyna v. Suno, Inc., and S.A. Jamendo v. Suno Inc., all in the District Court, D. Massachusetts. Others are Gerencia 360 Music, Inc. v. Suno, Inc. and Round Hill Music LP v. Suno, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California, Gawronski v. Suno Inc. in the District Court, S.D. Texas, Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc. in the District Court, S.D. New York, and Woulard v. Suno, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. Illinois. The largest concentration of these cases is in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
